input:
Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，一个男人觉得植物很有意思。他叫神农。有的植物吃了以后他的肚子疼死了，可是有的吃了以后很舒服。他找很多植物。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. At the point where the character feels pain, add a physical reaction to show how serious it is: “有的植物吃了以后，他的肚子疼得不得了。”
2. When mentioning the plants he looks for, add one visual detail to make the scene easier to imagine: “他找了很多植物，有的花是黄色的，像星星一样。”

ideas.reason: “肚子疼死了” already shows that the pain is very serious.
It adds a simple visual detail without changing the story.
